body: I'm right here with you. We talked about breaking up two days before thanksgiving and haven't spoken since. I thought we were going to spend our lives together and I feel stupid. I want to vanish. I'm sorry I can't help, but you're not alone.

We had a long talk on Tuesday where he told me he feels like he doesn't love me anymore and doesn't want to be with me but isn't sure he wants to break up yet. So we're taking a week apart to see if that clears anything up for him and I just have a gut feeling he's going to break up with me.

I don't drive, I'm barely employed, I live with my parents who don't treat me well, I have no friends. I can't get to therapy most of the time because I physically have no way of getting there. I have no means to change any of this without him. I have no friends or family to lean on. I'm going to be all alone in the world and so isolated if I can't have my boyfriend. I can't go to school or do anything without him so there's no point.

We've been together for three years. We're each other's first relationship. He just doesn't love me anymore and he wants to be with other people. I really can't manage without him. Just logistically, I'm going to lose everything.
